title: Corporation Tax: CT620 Notes
text:
These notes include information about:

 • why you have received a CT620 and any action you need to take

 • when to make a payment, including group payment arrangements

 • what will happen if you overpay Corporation Tax

 • whether you can appeal or apply to postpone payment of tax

 • why we might use estimated figures

 Read detailed information about Corporation Tax .
changeNote: Information about CT620 AMD, AMK, ASA, CLA, CLO, COR, DET and DIS notices have been updated to explain why you may receive a notice, what your options are and when to make a payment. The 'Payment of tax' and 'Appeals' sections have also been updated with more information and links to relevant guidance.
